course_outline_concepts: Per-run variance: dropout / temperature / prompt-permutation seeds; how to bound each
Bootstrap CIs at the item level — the cheap confidence estimate that most papers omit
Comparing two checkpoints: paired bootstrap, sign test, the 'two-run minimum' rule
Rolling averaging across checkpoints; smoothing vs masking real regressions
Writing the go/no-go memo: what claim, what evidence, what reviewer expected to check

sources.what_to_extract: Effective sample size as the right unit for noise; quality as a scaling variable; corpora with identical token count can sit on different scaling curves — same applies to eval sets and why N items is the denominator of every CI.

Production post-training scale; six-round iterative loop as the setting where per-round regressions must be distinguished from noise; RM-gated rejection sampling where the noise budget is dominated by RM variance rather than decode variance.
Reports SFT → DPO → RLVR per-stage gains as single-digit pp; these are exactly the regime where CI width vs item count (N) is decision-relevant; stage-by-stage eval discipline as the published norm.

Model-flow framing: multiple branches (Base, Think, Instruct, RL Zero) from one base demand reproducible go/no-go evidence per branch; OLMES eval harness + 1000+ intermediate checkpoints as the exact setting where rolling averaging matters.

Position bias flips 20–30% of judgments (swap-and-average); verbosity bias; self-enhancement bias — every LLM-as-judge eval inherits a variance floor from these that bootstrap CIs must include, not wash out.

Training fails silently; predict-outcome-before-run; review the 10 worst validation examples; 'don't be a hero' — each line of the go/no-go memo is a Karpathy-style falsifiable prediction paired with evidence.
Averaged metrics hide tail degradation; audit per-cluster, not only globally — the same applies to eval metrics: bootstrap at the slice level or you miss regressions that average out.
RL gains are conditional on headroom + boundary; distinguishing true capability from noise requires paired evaluation at the same prompts; motivates paired bootstrap over unpaired CI subtraction.

Gold reward rises, peaks, falls — monitoring on a rolling window or you ship a regression; smoothing hides the peak, masking the wrong bug; the reason rolling-average vs mask is a decision, not a default.

hard_rules: No external CDN references in HTML (inline CSS/JS only)
Bootstrap CI derivation and sign-test formulation must be mathematically correct
Variance magnitudes must be labeled as illustrative ranges when not attested in a specific paper number
Quote attested parameter values from raw-data sources; label inferred defaults when not attested
